newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips to supply decoders to CanalSatelite.
newsitem.headline: Philips to supply decoders to CanalSatelite.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Tuesday it would be a major supplier of digital set-top boxes to Spanish digital television operator Sogecable's CanalSatelite Digital channel.
"This sizeable contract involves the supply of digital reception terminals (STBs). Volume supplies will start now and run into the next century," Philips said in a statement.
No financial details were given, but a Philips spokeswoman said the deal would secure the company a minimum share of a half of CanalSatelite's STB requirements going forward.
"Philips is close to securing further deals," the statement said.
Sogecable SA is a unit of France's Canal Plus SA and Spain's Promotora de Informaciones SA.
